I implemented `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` to round half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

`tax_for` was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. It now multiplies `amount_cents` by `rate` using `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It returns an `int`. The rate goes through `str()` first, so a float like `0.0825` isn't affected by binary float error. For example, 10 cents at 5% is 0.5, which now rounds to 1.

An EngramDB memory recorded the March 2026 decision to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) and said not to use half-up. I updated that memory to say half-up, as of today, and noted that it replaces the March decision. I did that on your word that Finance changed their mind. If the memory was right and the policy hasn't actually changed, tell me and I'll revert both.
